notes.title: Avalon Legends Solitaire 3 coming soon
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Avalon Legends Solitaire 3 is coming soon to Steam.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/841980/Avalon_Legends_Solitaire_3/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/841980/Avalon_Legends_Solitaire_3/[/url]

Join forces with the Elves to protect the wilds of Avalon!

This is our third instalment in the realms of Avalon. Make the story complete. Visit Avalon Legends Solitaire 3 store page and add it to your wish list to not miss the launch.
